name: health-data-registry
description: Public infectious-disease data from CDC, WHO and other publishers, with the source of every number.
long_description: A read-only tool that answers plain questions about infectious disease with public, population-level data from CDC, WHO and other publishers. Every answer names its source, version and method. It never asks for patient data. It runs on your computer through uv, a small free program from Astral; tick "Install uv if missing" if uv isn't installed yet.

install_uv.title: Install uv if missing
install_uv.description: This tool runs through uv, a small free program from Astral. If it isn't on this computer, install it from astral.sh the first time the tool starts.

data_folder.title: Data folder
data_folder.description: Where downloaded public datasets are kept on this computer.
